design_gotchas.title: Single-Letter 'U' Suffix Reverses SOT-23-5 Pinout (Matches LMV321IDBVR, Breaks TLV9001IDBVR PCBs)
design_gotchas.detail: TLV9001UIDBVR (marking 1ODF) uses the U-pinout (Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 3 = IN-, Pin 4 = OUT) specifically as a drop-in upgrade for LMV321IDBVR. Standard TLV9001IDBVR (marking 1OGF) has Pin 1 = OUT, Pin 3 = IN+, Pin 4 = IN-. Never mix U and non-U reels on the SMT line.

design_gotchas.title: Massive Upgrade Over LMV321IDBVR — Verify Feedback Impedance & Higher Slew Rate (2 V/µs)
design_gotchas.detail: Compared with LMV321IDBVR (2.7-5.5 V, 7 mV max VOS, 15 nA IB, 130 µA Iq, non-RRI), TLV9001UIDBVR operates down to 1.8 V with full RRIO, 1.6 mV max VOS, 5 pA CMOS bias, 60 µA Iq, 2 V/µs slew rate, and integrated EMI/RFI filters.

design_gotchas.title: CMRR Crossover Region Within 1.4 V of Positive Rail
design_gotchas.detail: CMRR is 95 dB typ while VCM < (V+) - 1.4 V, but drops to 77 dB typ (63 dB min) across the full rail-to-rail crossover region up to (V+) + 0.1 V as the complementary input stage hands off.

design_gotchas.title: Input ESD Clamp Diodes Require Series Limiting Above ±0.5 V Beyond Rails
design_gotchas.detail: Input pins are diode-clamped to V+ and V- (abs max (V-)-0.5 V to (V+)+0.5 V). Signals swinging beyond the rails must be current-limited to <= 10 mA via series resistors.

typical_use_cases: Direct pin-for-pin RRIO CMOS upgrade for legacy LMV321IDBVR SOT-23-5 footprints
1.8 V to 5.5 V low-side current sensing and sensor front-end conditioning
Wearable, smoke detector, and battery IoT active filters requiring 60 µA Iq
Capacitive-load buffers driving up to 500 pF directly without external isolation
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV9001UIDBVR is the dedicated U-pinout 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) variant of the 1 MHz, 60 µA rail-to-rail input/output (RRIO) TLV9001 CMOS op-amp, engineered as a direct pin-compatible upgrade for LMV321IDBVR footprints (Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 2 = V-, Pin 3 = IN-, Pin 4 = OUT, Pin 5 = V+). Operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V over -40°C to 125°C, it improves upon LMV321 with ±1.6 mV max offset, 5 pA bias current, 2 V/µs slew rate, and integrated EMI/RFI filtering. Engineers must strictly separate TLV9001UIDBVR (marking 1ODF) from standard-pinout TLV9001IDBVR (marking 1OGF).

audit_notes: Vision-verified Figure 6-2 & Table 6-1 on 300 DPI PNG page 7 confirming TLV9001U DBV U-pinout: Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 2 = V-, Pin 3 = IN-, Pin 4 = OUT, Pin 5 = V+ (matches LMV321IDBVR, opposite of TLV9001IDBVR).

Verified Absolute Maximum Ratings (7 V, TJ = 150°C), Recommended Operating Conditions (1.8-5.5 V, -40 to 125°C), and DBV Thermal Information (RθJA = 232.9 °C/W, RθJC(top) = 153.8 °C/W) on 300 DPI PNG pages 14-15.
Verified Electrical Characteristics on 300 DPI PNG pages 17-18: GBW = 1 MHz, SR = 2 V/µs, VOS = ±1.6 mV max, IB = ±5 pA, IQ = 60 µA typ, CMRR = 77 dB typ, en = 30 nV/√Hz @ 1 kHz, ISC = ±40 mA.
Ordering table PNG page 40 confirms TLV9001UIDBVR Active, Production, SOT-23 (DBV) 5-pin, 3000 LARGE T&R, -40 to 125°C, marking 1ODF.
